name: Bold Upsell
summary: Shopify upsell app by Bold: AI-picked and manual upsells, cross-sells, order bumps, free gifts and subscription offers on product pages, cart and drawer and after purchase, with checkout offers for Shopify Plus stores and an AOV dashboard.
best_for: Shopify stores on the Basic or Grow plan that want upsells, cross-sells, free gifts and post-purchase offers across product page, cart and thank-you page for a flat monthly fee that does not grow with order volume
skip_if: your store is on Shopify Advanced and the $74.99 price buys nothing a Basic store does not get; you want in-checkout upsells without Shopify Plus; or you cannot risk an app that edits orders and discounts on a live store without a test window longer than seven days
honest_knock: Bold Upsell is priced by your Shopify plan, so a store on Shopify Advanced pays $74.99 a month for exactly the feature list a Basic store gets for $4.99, and checkout offers need Shopify Plus at $399.99 a month. The 7-day trial is short for judging an upsell app. The reviews are mostly warm, but 50 of 594 are one- or two-star, and the recent ones are specific: add-to-cart and checkout rates down 70% after offers went live (January 2026), the app failing at its one job with support silent for days or weeks (edited October 2026), and the app stopping without notice (November 2025). The data access is wide, including viewing sensitive customer data and editing orders and discounts. We have not run the app ourselves; this dossier is read from the listing and its reviews.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Shopify Basic · per month, the price follows your Shopify plan: $24.99 on Grow, $74.99 on Advanced, $399.99 on Plus
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-06 on the Shopify App Store listing at apps.shopify.com/product-upsell, prices in USD) Four plans, and you do not choose between them: each is named after a Shopify plan, so the app costs what your store's own Shopify plan dictates. Shopify Basic is $4.99 a month, Shopify Grow $24.99, Shopify Advanced $74.99 and Shopify Plus $399.99. Each carries a 7-day free trial. The feature list is the same on the first three: Smart AI upsell offers, cart page and cart drawer offers, custom cross-sells and 'true' upsells, funnel offers, post-purchase offers, free gift offers, subscription offers and a rewards announcement bar. The Plus plan adds checkout offers, the only feature that appears on one card alone. The listing calls this flat-rate monthly pricing: nothing is metered on orders, views or the revenue the app generates. All charges are billed in USD, and recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days.

compare_with.name: Selleasy
compare_with.why: Selleasy is in our dossiers too, and it prices the opposite way. Read on 19 September 2026, its Shopify listing charges by your store's monthly order count: free up to 50 orders, $9 from 51 to 500, $19 to 1,000 and $29 above that, with a 30-day trial, and the vendor's own page adds a $49 Pro tier that includes checkout upsells for Shopify Plus stores. Bold Upsell ignores order count and follows your Shopify plan: $4.99 on Basic, $74.99 on Advanced, $399.99 on Plus. So a busy store on Shopify Basic is cheaper on Bold ($4.99 against $29), a quieter store on Advanced is cheaper on Selleasy, and a Plus store that wants checkout upsells pays $49 on Selleasy's Pro against $399.99 on Bold. Price both at your own Shopify plan and order count before you choose.
